description: This PHP source file defines the SubPanelSearchForm class, which extends SearchForm to provide specialized search form functionalities for subpanels within the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for displaying the search form, handling subpanel-specific offsets, and retrieving collection lists based on the subpanel's configuration.
